Not what it seems - Buyer beware!. I have recently become very interested in taking care of plants and have amassed a bit of a collection, so naturally I was eager to give this app a try. Stupidly, I went ahead and purchased a lifetime subscription which was $59.99. This app seemed very neat and I liked the features that it advertised.

However, I quickly discovered that this app is janky and incredibly inaccurate, and cannot identify common plants despite taking clear, focused pictures. For example, telling me that my Persian shield is a Chinese violet repeatedly when it bears no resemblance whatsoever… Even the app’s date calculation is incredibly messed up. Like, when on April 28 I set a reminder to fertilize a plant on May 25, it was telling me it was a bizarre number of days away, and it would differ each time I re-entered it. At first it was 60-some, and continuously changed until it was saying it was 365 days away… Uh, yeah, the math’s not mathing there.

The app also has major issues with crashing, specifically when deleting a plant from your library. The user interface is non-functional, and will not let you click on things that should be able to be opened, won’t even let you view what kind of subscription you have. And no, my phone is relatively newer and does NOT have these issues any other time.

Thankfully Apple refunded my purchase, but this app is a complete sham. Do not waste your time or money.
